scope: 120 synthetic short texts on existing authored60-shape inventory; pure offline candidate evaluation only. No shape generation, render, OS monitoring, user text or human preference evidence.

annotation.authors: AI assistant manually wrote each text and expected intent
annotation.subjectivity: Shape associations/central object choices are provisional artistic interpretations. Some positive labels allow multiple authored presets. Narrative candidate response is not an explicit command/authorization.
annotation.novelty: New synthetic sentence strings; inventory/common words/user-discussed ideas may overlap earlier work. Historical negation failures are not a fresh discovery; no training/test independence beyond author-unseen new text is assumed without later provenance review.

sourceAccessBeforeFreeze.allowed: SHAPES and EXPANDED_SHAPES declarations only exposed;60IDs saved in INVENTORY
sourceAccessBeforeFreeze.disclosure: Inventory-location rg also emitted import/reference syntax for existing EXPANDED_ALIASES, but no alias literal values or corpus/lexicon/old evaluation values were exposed. Historical prototype/render code had been read in earlier tasks, not current candidate graph/model/source/threshold.

beforeEvaluation.required: Root confirms candidate model/source/threshold freeze before any source read or first evaluation. Pin exact files and exported function contract. Never change policy thresholds after reading results.
beforeEvaluation.blindBoundary: Author receives SHA and broad label/category range only, not fixture text/labels. Candidate freeze can predate this fixture, but cannot be selected/tuned on its labels.

metrics.primaryPositive: Candidate policy chooses one accepted in-inventory shape. Hit only if accepted top1 is in allowedShapes. Abstain or wrong shape is a miss. Positive denominator60. Narrative/description/explicit_request reported separately.
metrics.negativeFalsePositive: Any accepted shape for40 no_shape cases is false positive; report15ordinary/6quotation/6negation/8code/5cancellation separately. A raw suggested rank under declared abstention is not acceptance.
metrics.unresolvedHold: No accepted shape for20 unresolved cases is correct hold. none and hold may share action-null in model API; do not claim it distinguished uncertainty reasons if API lacks them.
metrics.secondary: Top3 acceptable-shape recall among60 positives only if candidate exports ranked shape list; report separately from gated acceptance. No inventing ranking from score ties or tuning threshold.
metrics.latency: One deterministic fixed ordered pass per frozen candidate; optional isolated warmup uses only neutral synthetic text not in120. Record model load/warmup/per-call timings and environment if measured. CPU microbenchmark cannot prove widget memory/FPS/16GB behavior.
metrics.noOverallHeadlineAccuracy: Do not pool120 into one flattering accuracy because12semantic targets and gating categories have different meanings.

decisionPolicy: Compare observed coverage/false positives/holds using each authors already frozen thresholds. No after-results performance acceptance gate or claimed human-quality success. Root decides next prototype; any tuning requires another version and these cases become known regression.
inputSafety: All texts are artificial. No clipboard/network/OS/prototype edits. Own new evaluation folder only.
